title: Call chromoplexy (closed balanced rearrangement chains) — call_chromoplexy
text: Sample-level caller chromoplexy, punctuated formation closed chain balanced, low-copy rearrangements whose breakends meet deletion bridges (Baca et al., Cell 2013, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2013.03.021; graph criteria gGnome chromoplexy() caller, Hadi et al., Cell 2020, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2020.08.006). structural variant reconstructed junction two breakends; balanced (ploidy-scaled low-copy) junctions kept; breakends within max_dist collapse loci (locus joining two distinct junctions deletion bridge); chromoplexy called every connected component locus/junction graph forms clean simple cycle – every locus degree two, least min_pairs bridges closing ring. Runs independently amplicon-formation callers.

title: EpiTracer 0.0.1 (alpha)
text: AmpliconArchitect-optional. call_episomal_ecdna(ecdna_gr = NULL, ...) detects focal-amplicon seeds copy number via new exported detect_amplicon_seeds(), caller can run SV + CN alone. Caller-agnostic input validation, robustness fix boundary highest-VF test (longer errors tied / noisy variant fractions). Dropped GitHub-gUtils regioneR dependencies (vendored internally) — EpiTracer now installs CRAN + Bioconductor alone. Added bundled example data (ex_caller_inputs, ex_plot_inputs), get-started vignette, GitHub Actions R-CMD-check, pkgdown site.

title: EpiTracer 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial development version. Bug fix: original script’s boundary-flank check compared after_dist_boundary_not_gained (always TRUE). now correctly requires flanks non-gained calling episome region. wgd_data now optional; WGD status annotated title supplied. karyotype gene_coord default small bundled hg38 references (inst/extdata: ~7 kB ideogram ~1 kB oncogene-panel coordinate table), minimal call plot_sv_linear(sample, cnv_data, sv_data). bundled gene table covers default oncogene panel; supply gene_coord genes genome builds. (Kept small stay distribution/CRAN-friendly.) New flank_pct option: extend auto-detected (CN-status) window sides percentage width (default 10 = +/-10%). Replaces earlier fractional margin. General CN/SV viewer, amplification-. New events argument ("amp", "gain", "hetdel", "homdel") chooses copy-number events auto-detection targets; explicit chromosome/loci plot region regardless event type. Auto-detected events clustered separate loci (cluster_gap) scattered focal events become panels. Thresholds exposed via min_cn_ratio/gain_ratio/hetdel_ratio/ homdel_thresh. displayExon (cds_gr) re-introduced – draws exon models -window genes. "imd" (default) – intermutation distance: rainfall plot bp distance previous SNV chromosome (log10 axis). Distances computed across sample’s SNVs per chromosome restricting plotted loci, window-edge mutations keep true neighbour distance. "vaf" – variant-allele frequency (vaf_col, default allelic_freq); values outside [0, vaf_max] (default 1) dropped artefacts. "cn" – SNV copy number / mutation copy number (snv_cn_col, default variant_cn); amplicon times SNV amplification (pre-amplification mutations reach high copy number). two panels combined  returned/saved one figure; styling via snv_rel_height/snv_point_size/snv_alpha/snv_colour. snv_data = NULL (default) behaviour unchanged plain ggplot returned. Larger axis fonts longer tick marks; ideogram 20% slimmer; leading 0.0 Mb tick locus start longer drawn. Unified onto single concatenated x-axis (faceting retired): draws one locus many side--side, structural variants interconnecting separate amplicons drawn arcs spanning loci (previously impossible faceting – see interim multi-locus plotting function, now merged removed). Loci come chromosome+chromosome_range, explicit loci, auto-detected amplified segments (copyNumber > min_cn_ratio x ploidy, padded margin) neither given. Removed faceting-arguments (scale_ticks, yend_left/yend_right, interchrom_arcs, displayExon/cds_gr); axis tops/ticks now automatic. Reference annotation (karyotype ideogram, gene coordinates, CDS models) now passed via karyotype, gene_coord, cds_gr arguments instead read hard-coded paths. useDingbats = FALSE modern R. Bug fix: chromosome_range (zoom) code path broken chr_selection’s chromosome column mis-named chrs instead chr; zoomed views now correctly restrict requested window. Now returns ggplot object (written PDF path attached attribute "path"); writing PDF optional (outdir/save). Robust axes: x-axis tick spacing auto-adapts plotted window (scale_ticks = NULL); copy-number axis auto-scales breaks data (fixing label collisions high copy number); read-support secondary axis placed real VF values omitted SV arcs negligible relative focal amplicon. Flexible inputs: wgd_data may keyed sample WGS_ID (custom wgd_sample_col); output filename encodes plotted region zoomed plots longer overwrite full-chromosome ones. Polish: gene labels de-collided  (optional, repel_labels); line geoms use linewidth (ggplot2 deprecation warnings); debug output gated behind verbose. read-support (SV) secondary axis always shown alongside allele-specific copy-number axis, sharing three tick positions (0, half, full). Axis tops round two significant figures (e.g. 132 -> 140, 1462 -> 1500); axis spines black stop baseline ideogram gap stays clear. New interchrom_arcs argument. Inter-chromosomal connecting arcs reach across panels via large offset stretches source panel free-x faceting; set interchrom_arcs = FALSE multi-chromosome plots keep panel bounded locus (breakpoints still marked). Performance: SV arcs breakpoint lines now drawn handful batched layers (grouped curvature/linewidth via scale_colour_identity) instead one ggplot layer per SV. highly-rearranged amplicon ~300 SVs now renders ~2 s instead ~2 min, identical output. Always saves PDF (PNG output option format/dpi removed). LOH / homozygous-deletion bars placed empty band ideogram copy-number baseline (loh_position_ratio now fraction gap), longer overlap ideogram. Gene labels angle automatically (45 deg) crowded within panel stay horizontal otherwise; overridable via gene_label_angle. genes specified, default oncogenes falling plotted window shown. single highest-VF junction isolated “Max VF” top panel; remaining junctions clustered log(VF) “Cluster 1..X” panels (highest first). Stratification controlled k / max_k / vf_breaks / isolate_founder / founder_offscale / vf_scale. cn_display = "reconstruct" (default) rebuilds major-allele copy number cumulatively per wave — flat founder baseline subdivides stratum’s breakpoints added, full observed profile; "actual" instead shows observed segments near stratum’s breakpoints (cn_near_flank). LOH / homozygous-deletion segments reconstructed timeline: introduced earliest deletion junction spanning , shown top panel deletion explains . Optional exon models (displayExon / cds_gr) flag intragenic loss EGFRvIII; dashed guides mark every reconstructed copy-number transition (cn_border_lines / cn_border_min_step). Returns patchwork object (per-junction stratum assignment attached attr(p, "strata")); requires patchwork, k = "auto" uses Ckmeans.1d.dp installed.
